title: Internal: booking the final demurrage line of a container record
content:
## Scope

Under the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category, the final charges of a per-container record are booked once its clocks have stopped. This entry covers the final **demurrage** line of the record and the internal tool that books it.

## When it applies

Once the last clock of a record has stopped, its final demurrage line is booked with the demurrage days used beyond free time, the first and last demurrage day billed, and the amount.

## Business effect of the booking

- A new demurrage invoice entry dated today is written on the record, carrying the demurrage days billed, the first and last demurrage day covered and the amount.
- The amount is added to the balance the billed party owes on the record, and the record shows as invoiced.
- The entry is import demurrage on an import record and export demurrage on an export record.
- The customer can then see the demurrage line and the higher balance.

## How it is invoked

The tool is **book_demurrage_invoice_a2ad21e7**, an internal tool that the agent must first unlock (through unlock_agent_discoverable_tool) and then call (through call_agent_discoverable_tool).

## Parameters

- **dnd_id**: reference number of the free-time record being invoiced, as returned by the free-time record lookup; an identifier.
- **chargeable_days**: demurrage days billed beyond free time; an integer number of calendar days.
- **period_start_date**: first demurrage day covered by the line, written YYYY-MM-DD.
- **period_end_date**: last demurrage day covered by the line, written YYYY-MM-DD.
- **amount_usd**: demurrage amount of the line in USD, a positive figure given to 2 decimal places and rounded to the cent before it is passed.

## Return

A successful booking answers "Demurrage invoice line (invoice reference) booked on record (record reference): (days) day(s) from (start) to (end), USD (amount); balance due now USD (balance)." The invoice reference is the identifier customers quote for this line and the identifier that later waivers and credits refer to; the balance is the record's outstanding amount in USD to 2 decimal places after the line. An answer starting with "Error:" means no record exists under that reference and nothing was booked.

## Contract questions

**Q: Where does the invoice reference of the demurrage line come from?**
A: From the receipt of this booking; it is the reference later waivers and credits point at.

**Q: Is the entry dated on the last demurrage day?**
A: No. The entry carries today's date; the covered days are given by the two period parameters.
